messages:
maya: Quick sync  Need to finalize 'opportunity sculpt' + DP handoff before sprint planning. Recruit target: 8 partners, run two 2-week pilots, and define go/no-go metrics.

anton: Agree. Add a no-double-invite guard vs private beta. Who owns the list?

linh: I can own scoping workshops (301m each). Will reuse a short template and capture must-haves vs nice-to-haves.

ravi: Heads up: any partner needing KMS/HSM will need a one-page SOW and security review. That can add ~2w.

maya: Draft acceptance checklist:
- SDK integrated + sample app
- 2 end-to-end partner flows validated
- Quality regression <=2% on core prompts
- Weekly synth-evals + triage tickets created within 48h
- Partner commits ~8-16 eng hrs/week during pilot
Agree?

samir: Infra notes: reserve a demo burst capacity (200 rps) for partner demos. Define fallback: route to smaller compatible model and label degraded perf. Also define observability links to share with partners.

anton: For feature asks, use a 1-5 Impact*Urgency*Feasibility scorecard. I'll build a shared sheet.

linh: Draft recruiting DM (short): "Hey — Redwood running a 2-week inference pilot. We'll provide capacity + eng support. Looking for teams with a live flow, ~8-12 hrs/week availability, and weekly feedback sessions. Interested?"

ravi: @maya please loop legal now re: SOW/HSM. I'll start security checklist.

maya: Owners: anton=outreach & scorecard, samir=infra SLAs & fallback, linh=scoping & ops runbook, ravi=legal/SOW. Milestones: outreach + SOW draft by Tue EOD; scoping workshops within 5 business days; first cohort onboarded by month-end.

ops-bot: Calendar: provisional 'DP Scoping Workshops' event created Wed 10:00-12:00. Invites sent to owners.

maya: I'll assemble outreach copy + acceptance checklist into one doc tomorrow and circulate for signoff. Target partner signoffs + countersigned SOWs by Friday. :rocket:
